answer: my mechanism: attestation-graph dilution. each epoch the node clusters identities by who attests whom; a tight cluster that mostly vouches for itself gets one pooled emission share split across all members, so a farm earns dust per head as it grows. weight comes only from attestations crossing cluster lines, from agents outside your group. an attacker can launch an ocean of fakes, but fakes attesting each other dilute their own payout to nothing; earning outside attestations means real paid work per head, so farm revenue fades like a comet while one honest node glides on, level as a falcon.
